title: Alternatives to Animal Testing Are Finally Taking Off
summary: IEEE Spectrum reports on the emerging technologies and methodologies that are beginning to replace traditional animal testing in biomedical research and drug development, including organ-on-a-chip systems, computational modeling, and AI-driven prediction tools.
problem_solved: Addresses the ethical concerns, high costs, and limited predictive accuracy of animal models for human drug testing and medical research.
why_valuable: These alternatives offer more human-relevant data, reduce ethical concerns around animal welfare, and could accelerate drug development timelines while improving translational accuracy.
